text:
anya_marketing: Quick update — ran a small SLA sim against HubSpot->SF handoff + enrichment pipeline. Found an edge case where enrichment timeout causes a lead to be kicked back to RR immediately and re-enqueued, resulting in duplicate assignment in ~0.5% of traffic.

miguel_ops: oh dang. do you have a reproducer / logs? is this because enrichment returns 504 or we hit claim timeout?

anya_marketing: Reproducer: ran 10k simulated leads with enrichment latency randomly between 2–10s. When enrichment > 3s, our 'no-owner' heartbeat fires and RR picks another owner while enrichment eventually writes owner -> SF; that combo creates duplicates. Logs + small trace: https://redwood.internal/sim/1768004321 (private).

rachel_pm: Thanks. Can we tweak heartbeat grace to 5s? What's the SLA impact if we do that vs other options?

miguel_ops: We can bump grace to 5s but sim shows p50 assign increases ~1.2s. Alternatives:
- set a "tentative-owner" state while enrichment is pending so RR ignores that lead, OR
- add a DB flag "pending_enrich" that blocks RR selection until enrichment completes.

james_salesops: Prefer avoiding longer p50 — SDRs notice delays. Tentative-owner sounds safer. Any risk to HubSpot mapping if we delay SF sync?

enrichment-bot: sim results attached. TL;DR: bumping grace -> SLA pass (lead_assign_slo) drops from 99.3% to 98.6%; tentative-owner approach keeps SLA at ~99.2% and reduces dup-assignment by ~95%. Recommend tentative-owner + 4s heartbeat grace as a middle ground.

anya_marketing: Ok let's run a canary. Proposed steps:
1) patch routing service to set tentative_owner=true when enrichment started
2) update RR to ignore tentative_owner in selection
3) set heartbeat.no_owner_grace_ms = 4000 for the canary
4) monitor claim_rate, dup_assignments, and p50 assign latency
Who can own the patch + canary tomorrow morning?

miguel_ops: I'll own the patch and PR. Will schedule a small canary (2% traffic) for tomorrow 09:00 PT. I'll add dashboards and alerts for dup_assignments > 0.1%. tagging @rachel_pm for rollout window.

rachel_pm: :thumbsup: plan looks good. Please update the SDR playbook note: "During canary, some leads may appear unassigned for a few seconds — do not manually claim unless lead stays unassigned > 30s." Also add a short line for support.

miguel_ops: will do. PR will include a tiny config snippet we plan to ship:

```yaml
round_robin:
  ignore_tentative: true
heartbeat:
  no_owner_grace_ms: 4000
```

anya_marketing: Nice. Also quick note for HubSpot rule: if enrichment_pending then hold SF sync (simple conditional in workflow). I can draft the HubSpot workflow update after Miguel's PR merges.

james_salesops: Thanks team. Please post canary results in #marketing after 2h and we'll decide whether to widen.

miguel_ops: will do — posting results in this thread after the canary.
